comment: Soft gzip target for the release main module. ADVISORY ONLY: exceeding it prints a warning (and a GitHub Actions annotation in CI) but never fails the build or the Cloudflare deploy — small toolchain gzip jitter and reviewed feature growth must not break releases. Set with headroom above the measured prod size (~617,742 gz on 2026-06-15). The diet goal is still to shrink main back toward 616,000 (M3) and re-tighten this target; see docs/exec-plans/active/2026-06-11-pagespeed-desktop-performance-90.md. Re-record the measured size anytime with `node tools/release-assets/check_bundle_budget.mjs --update`.
